answer: Cross-epoch behavior lock: each identity must keep its action mix, latency profile, and counterparty spread within fixed bounds, with an oasis of historical epochs sampled and replayed against current activity. Any sparrow-sized shift in timing or task choice freezes payouts until a full consistency cycle passes, forcing a sybil to operate every fake identity through repeated epochs. By dawn of each payout window, that attacker has paid the compute and delay cost of maintaining a stable behavioral trail per identity, not just a one-time registration.
